title: Het Manual Action
description: A manual owner action requested by LucyOS. Complete it, record the result, and attach evidence when useful.

checks.title: Complete the requested action
checks.instruction: Read the task instructions above, perform only the requested manual action, then record whether it was completed.
checks.help: Use PASS when completed successfully, FAIL when attempted but unsuccessful, and SKIP only when the action cannot safely be performed. Enter the requested decision/result in the note field; for approvals, record the exact approved value.
checks.expected_result: The requested human action is completed and its result is recorded.
